text.p: This view shows a Gantt chart of task and ISR execution, like the vertical trace view, but with horizontal orientation.
This view does not show event labels like service calls or User Events, but it allows for correlating the detailed execution trace with other horizontal views, such as the CPU Load Graph.
To see a vertical scheduling view, which includes individual events along with the scheduling, use View -> Vertical View. See the Vertical Trace View for more information about this view.
If you click on a task or ISR instance, you can see additional information in the tool panel in the very right. Double-clicking on a task or ISR instance will show details about it.

You can select which actors to display in the trace by using the legend field on the right. Right-clicking in the legend gives options to "Show All" or "Show None", and if a legend entry is selected the option to "Show Only ..." is available.
